name: Six new composition candidates and two deliberate reuses

entries.name: Compare two useful options
entries.visitor_need: Compare the dimensions and care requirements of two shortlisted products before opening their details.
entries.difference: A labelled comparison matrix with one shared heading row and three horizontal specification bands, followed by one destination action.
acceptance: Real product specifications and a comparison destination; no invented best-seller claim.
Repeat option names in each stacked phone band so values never lose their label.

entries.name: Ask for a callback
entries.visitor_need: Request a call about a service without writing a full email enquiry.
entries.difference: A compact call-request slip with a short topic heading, one inset phone field and a separate What happens next footer.
acceptance: Use the shipping phone library and preserve country choice after a failed submission.
Collect only a phone number; describe an enquiry, not a booked callback time. Reject if it is merely an inline-phone recolour.

entries.name: Try a page before requesting the guide

entries.difference: A readable sample page with a narrow annotation margin, paired with a small request column. The sample is real editable text, not cover art.
acceptance: Supply an actual useful sample and an accessible complete resource.

entries.name: See the event essentials

entries.name: Know what happens after asking
entries.visitor_need: Understand the enquiry, assessment and separately agreed work stages before leaving a reply address.
entries.difference: Three ordered, horizontally arranged process columns above a compact email footer; phone view repeats each stage number with its description.
acceptance: Use only email initially; do not request budget or address unless the reply needs it.
Make clear that submitting neither books work nor guarantees an assessment deadline. Acknowledgement confirms the request only.
